initial_full_detector.method: Own read-only session interrupted through session Ctrl-C after prolonged traversal/matching. No global process termination.
initial_full_detector.inspection: Installed detector prunes ignored directories, but applies the lengthy explicit ignore pattern list to all encountered entries, including excluded siblings. Live CIM profiling unavailable in sandbox; no claim that excluded trees were actually traversed.

replacement.traversal: Explicit source files and required ancestor directories only, with installed detector classification, noise, sensitivity, word count and full ordered ignore-pattern checks unchanged.
replacement.scope_exhaustiveness: Exact generated root/child deny rules, required-directory inclusions and437 explicit-file inclusions match .graphifyignore bytes. No broad source inclusion.

diagnostic_ignore_timing.scope: One installed ignore check with a fresh ancestor cache, not a whole-refresh performance benchmark.
